assumptions: Γ has 1-point amalgamation (1PA): any two satisfiable Γ-instances sharing exactly one variable have a satisfiable union.
attrs.evidence: Block–cut induction. No split cycle ⟺ every block with ≥2 edges is monochromatic (Whitney: any two edges of a 2-connected graph lie on a common cycle), so each block is a sub-multiset of one satisfiable site. Blocks and cut vertices form a TREE; a leaf block meets the rest in exactly one variable; 1PA glues. Corroborated exhaustively: 0 violations over every no-split-cycle federation in a complete 4-variable enumeration at |D|=2 and |D|=3.
attrs.prior_art: PROVED HERE by block–cut induction. Beeri–Fagin–Maier–Yannakakis 1983 is the neighbouring classical result (pairwise ⟹ global consistency on α-acyclic schemes) and the block hypergraph is α-acyclic, but BFMY's pairwise consistency is STRICTLY STRONGER than 1PA's intersecting-projections condition, so this is not a restatement of it. Novelty is NOT claimed — an exact prior-art search has not been done. Explicitly NOT Freuder 1982, which assumes arc consistency of the whole network; CE-A satisfies this cell's antecedent and violates Freuder's.
attrs.statement: If Γ has 1-point amalgamation and no cycle of the union carrier is split across sites, then fidelity holds.
